title: HomeKit Weekly: Lafaer’s 5-in-1 presence sensor fixes an annoying automation in Apple Home
snippet: Motion-based automations are generally straightforward in Apple Home. The only carve-out is lighting, because some rooms are hard to judge by time of day alone. Depending on the windows and placement against the sun, some rooms might need light-based automations earlier in the day than others. The Lafaer 5-in-1 presence sensor fixes that with a light sensor most motion sensors lack, along with mmWave radar. more…
